title: Cell A runtime: Ollama with the pinned small model on Apple silicon
purpose: The required m23 runtime path for Cell A. Installs the dated v1 runtime, pulls the pinned small instruct model, proves first prompt, loopback, direct API, stop, and undo. Frozen fixture task: ticket classification (plan 06 amendment 3b-1). The reviewer machine has more than 8 GB. What we measured suggests it would fit on an 8 GB machine at 4096 context with room to spare, but we have not run it on one. Clean-machine install retest pending Phase 4 step 6 (runtime was verified at the recorded version on an existing install).
operating_system: macOS 13 or newer on Apple silicon
hardware_class: Cell A: Apple silicon, 8 GB or more unified memory
runtime_version: Install current from the official source; verified on 0.20.2 on this cell 2026-07-25; version drift is the first suspect if output differs
prerequisites: Homebrew installed, or the official installer from the runtime's download page
About 3 GB of free disk and a network connection for the one-time model pull
License reviewed: Qwen3.5-2B is Apache 2.0 (verify at the upstream repository); no remote code runs, GGUF weights only
estimated_download: 2.7 GB model artifact plus the runtime installer

steps.purpose: Install the runtime from an official source and start its service.
steps.command: brew install ollama && brew services start ollama
steps.expected_output: Homebrew reports the install, and brew services list shows ollama started.
steps.stop: brew services stop ollama stops the background service at any time.
steps.undo: brew services stop ollama && brew uninstall ollama removes the runtime; ~/.ollama (models) survives until you delete it.
common_errors: brew: command not found: install Homebrew first, or use the official macOS installer from the runtime's download page and skip the services commands.

steps.purpose: Record the exact runtime version; this recipe was verified against it.
steps.expected_output: ollama version is 0.20.2 (a newer version may work; this recipe's expected outputs were captured on 0.20.2).
common_errors: command not found: open a new terminal so PATH picks up the install.

steps.purpose: Pull the pinned small instruct model and record its digest.
steps.expected_output: Layer downloads then success; ollama list then shows qwen3.5:2b with ID 324d162be6ca and size 2.7 GB.
steps.stop: Ctrl+C is safe; rerunning the pull resumes or verifies.
steps.undo: ollama rm qwen3.5:2b removes the model (we ran this one; a later pull downloads it again).
common_errors: manifest unknown: check the exact model name and tag against the runtime's model library.

steps.purpose: First prompt. This model THINKS by default: the CLI streams its reasoning before the answer, and --hidethinking shows the answer alone.
steps.command: ollama run qwen3.5:2b --hidethinking "In one sentence, what is a context window?"
steps.expected_output: One short definition sentence. First response after a cold start takes a few seconds; warm responses are near-instant on Apple silicon.
steps.stop: The one-shot form exits by itself; in interactive mode, /bye exits.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; a prompt changes no state.
common_errors: Long pause before output: the model is loading into memory (cold start) or thinking; both are normal.

Empty content when calling the OpenAI-compatible API with a max_tokens cap: the thinking consumed the whole budget. Send reasoning_effort none on /v1/chat/completions, or think false on the native /api/chat route.

steps.purpose: Confirm the service binds loopback only. The documented default bind is 127.0.0.1:11434; anything else means your environment customized OLLAMA_HOST.
steps.expected_output: One ollama line ending 127.0.0.1:11434 (LISTEN). A line showing *:11434 means the service listens on EVERY interface: treat that as the m23-6 exposure drill, find the OLLAMA_HOST override, and decide on purpose.
steps.stop: Nothing to stop; lsof reads state.
common_errors: No output: the service is not running; start it and retry.

steps.purpose: Prove the HTTP surface with a direct request before any application code.
steps.expected_output: A JSON model list whose data array includes an entry with id qwen3.5:2b.
steps.stop: Nothing to stop; the request returns immediately.
steps.undo: Nothing to undo; a GET changes no state.
common_errors: Connection refused: the service is stopped; start it and retry.

steps.purpose: Practice a clean stop and restart of a serve process you own, without touching a shared service: run a second instance on loopback at another port, verify its bind, then stop it.
steps.expected_output: The serve process logs startup and stays attached; in a second terminal, lsof -nP -iTCP:11500 -sTCP:LISTEN shows 127.0.0.1:11500 only, and http://127.0.0.1:11500/api/version answers. Ctrl+C stops it cleanly.
steps.undo: Stopping it is the undo; it shares the model store and writes nothing new.
common_errors: bind: address already in use: pick another free port for the drill.

steps.purpose: Unload the model from memory when finished; the artifact stays on disk.
steps.expected_output: No output; ollama ps no longer lists the model, and memory is released.
steps.undo: The next prompt reloads it automatically.

health_check: ollama --version answers, lsof shows the loopback listener, and the /v1/models request lists qwen3.5:2b
expected_result: The pinned model pulls with the recorded digest, answers a first prompt, serves loopback HTTP, and stops cleanly. On the reviewer machine the ten-case ticket-classification smoke run (native API, thinking off, temperature 0) parsed 10 of 10 responses as valid JSON with about one second per warm response. Course-scaffold smoke rerun 2026-07-27 on the same machine (the shipped m2 structured-output-classifier template instantiated with the frozen fixture schema: inline schema block with the full enums, the two shipped few-shot examples, the template's one-retry rule): 10 of 10 first-pass responses valid against every TicketClassification enum, the retry rule never fired; fixture-expected category and urgency matched on 6 of 10 (oc-01 and oc-02 are few-shot members, so those two are memorization); warm responses averaged 1.5 s at about 66 tok/s.
expected_memory: about 4.1 GiB resident at 4096 context, observed 2026-07-25 on Apple silicon unified memory (about 4.6 GiB at the runtime's default 32768 context)
validated_context: 4096 course-validated (a 3,900-word document answered correctly); the model ships a far larger advertised context that this recipe makes no claim about
privacy_notes: The tested path needs no account and no API key.
Documented default bind is loopback; step 5 verifies YOUR machine instead of trusting the default, and a wildcard bind is treated as the exposure drill.
The one-time model pull is the only network use in this recipe; prompts run locally.
This recipe proves the declared path on the tested date, not universal privacy for every plugin, setting, or future version.
known_failures: Thinking consumes a capped token budget on the OpenAI-compatible route, returning empty content: send reasoning_effort none there, or think false on the native route.
Port 11434 already in use by another instance: the second serve exits with an address-in-use error.
Cold starts pause several seconds while weights load; not a hang.
OLLAMA_HOST customized in the environment changes the bind; step 5 catches it.
